title: The club takes off
description: A group of aerospace-passionate Centrale Casablanca students founds Centrale Aero Club (CAC) to bring aviation and space closer to campus life.

title: First technical departments
description: The club structures itself into two technical departments — Aeronautics and Aerospace — each running its own projects and workshops.

title: First flight-simulation corner
description: The club sets up a permanent flight-simulation station, opening real flight procedures to every student on campus.

title: The telescope arrives
description: The club acquires its own telescope and launches regular astronomy nights, turning the campus rooftop into an observatory.

title: Space Day 2025
description: The flagship event dedicated to AI, Earth observation and space engineering, gathering students, researchers and industry guests.

title: Space architecture conference
description: Conference with Ismail El Omari, space architect and analog astronaut, on designing for life beyond Earth.

title: A new bureau, a bigger vision
description: The 2026 board takes office with an ambitious roadmap: Aero Day, national aerospace challenges, company visits and deeper industry partnerships.
